Handbrake - video transcoder (Xenial & newer)

PPA description

Latest Handbrake 1.7.3 for Bionic & newer (and 1.1.2 for Xenial old GTK).

*** Handbrake builds here need the private PPA for successful install! ***

*** Please always see https://launchpad.net/~savoury1 for general updates about this Launchpad site before contacting me or reporting any bugs! ***

*** Big thanks to all those who have donated to support this project, you are very directly helping to keep it alive! To all who have not donated: please do so if you can afford it, this project depends on donations. ***

If software at this site is useful to you then please consider a donation:

*** Donations: https://paypal.me/Savoury1 & https://ko-fi.com/Savoury1 ***
*** Also https://patreon.com/Savoury1 & https://liberapay.com/Savoury1 ***

Update (14 Apr 2025): Handbrake 1.7.3 builds with latest SVT-AV1 3.0.2 and x264 4.1 (also including package for Ubuntu 24.04, upgrading from 1.7.2).

Update (28 Feb 2023): Handbrake 1.6.1+git builds are now with FFmpeg 6.0, and require FFmpeg 6.0 to run. So ppa:savoury1/ffmpeg6 must also be added!

Update (26 Nov 2022): Handbrake 1.5.1 builds here are now with FFmpeg 5.x and require FFmpeg 5.x to run, so ppa:savoury1/ffmpeg5 must also be added!

*** Install ***

To run Handbrake successfully FFmpeg >= 6.0 is now required for all series which requires the FFmpeg 4 PPA (Ubuntu LTS < 24.04 only). FFmpeg >= 6.0 requires access to the private PPA and any who have donated can contact me to request such access. After access to the private PPA is setup do this:

  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/ffmpeg6
  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/handbrake
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install handbrake

Note for Ubuntu LTS < 24.04: Do the following before the above commands:

  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/ffmpeg4

A PPA for Xenial with backported GTK 3.22 (and associated packages) [*] allows running the latest Handbrake (and latest of other programs) on an upgraded Xenial system (PPA also has Handbrake 1.7.3 build for Xenial).

[*] https://launchpad.net/~savoury1/+archive/ubuntu/gtk-xenial

*** Build ***

This PPA has build dependencies on:

  ppa:savoury1/build-tools
  ppa:savoury1/backports
  ppa:savoury1/graphics
  ppa:savoury1/multimedia
  ppa:savoury1/ffmpeg4

Adding this PPA to your system

You can update your system with unsupported packages from this untrusted PPA by adding ppa:savoury1/handbrake to your system's Software Sources. (Read about installing) 

sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/handbrake
sudo apt update
Technical details about this PPA

This PPA can be added to your system manually by copying the lines below and adding them to your system's software sources.

Display sources.list entries for: 
deb https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/savoury1/handbrake/ubuntu YOUR_UBUNTU_VERSION_HERE main 
deb-src https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/savoury1/handbrake/ubuntu YOUR_UBUNTU_VERSION_HERE main
